book.name: Madyu
book.title: Madyu Jisas Krais Manö Aij u Madyu kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: Jisas nɨp ai göl gun al pak lun, a göm, agamɨj hag nɨŋla
Jisas manö anɨbu hagöm, bɨ nɨpe unbö mɨgan laŋ gau kalɨp haga,

“Kale nɨŋbim, ñɨn mɨhöp mɨdöm, Pasopa ñɨn kub u mɨñi, a göm, ap magum göm yɨharɨŋ mɨdeinaböl. Pen kale anɨg göl ap magum göm, yɨp Bɨ Ñɨ nɨpe u, ud gapman bɨ kub gau kalɨp ñöm hagnaböl, ‘Nɨp mab ba laŋ al pak lɨmim,’ a gɨnaböl,” a ga.
Pen God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau abe, bɨ manö ud asɨkep gau abe apöm bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub yabɨƚ Kaiapas ram kub nɨpe u magum göm,
Jisas nɨp ai göl gun, agamɨj ud sɨsɨ lun, al pak lɨnabun, a göm, manö hag lɨ mɨdeila.
Pen kale hagla, “Pasopa nan ñɨŋeb yɨharɨŋ mɨdep ñɨn i, hon anɨg gɨno, nɨbi bɨ iru nöp mɨdpal gai i pen pen göl rö löp. Anɨb u, mɨñi arö gun, ñɨn ap nɨp al pak lun,” a gɨla.
Nɨbi ap Jisas nabɨc cög nɨp wel lɨ ña

Jisas ram rɨƚɨg agƚö Bedani am mɨdöm, Saimon bɨ wös hapeb nöd la u ram nɨpe u am nan ñɨŋeila. Nan ñɨŋlö nɨŋöl gɨ, nɨbi ap wel haƚɨŋ aij auep, mani kub raubal u, barol halö dapöm, Jisas nabɨc cög adö u hoŋ ga.
Hoŋ gö, Jisas bɨ nɨpe gau nɨŋlö, hibur kale u naij gö, hagla, “Wel anɨbu damöm mani kub udöm, nɨbi bɨ nan mɨdagöp gau kalɨp ñeb rö u, pen nɨhön gɨnɨg anɨg göl yɨharɨŋ hoŋ göp?” ö gɨla.
Manö anɨbu hageila, Jisas ke nɨŋöm, kalɨp haga, “Nɨbi anɨbi nɨpe yɨp gɨ aij yabɨƚ göp u, nɨhön gɨnɨg anɨg hagabim?
Nɨbi bɨ nan mɨdagöp gau aip pör mɨdeinabim, pen yad aip pör mɨdageinabun.
Nɨbi bɨ umlö, wip rɨgöl gɨnɨg, wel lɨ ñöm dam rɨgöl gɨpal. Yɨp rɨgöl gɨnɨg gaböl u me, nɨpe wel anɨbu hañ romaŋ yɨp lɨ ñöb.
Pen yad kalöp nɨŋö hagabin, hainö ram mɨnöŋ iƚ i ke gau gau magöŋhalö, manö aij yad u hagöl gɨ, nɨbi anɨbi anɨg gajɨp u aiud udöl gɨ, ga anɨbu hauƚ gagnaböl,” a ga.
Judas Jisas nɨp mumug nɨŋa

Ñɨn anɨbu, Jisas bɨ nɨpe Judas Iskariod, Jisas nɨp kain gɨ dam ñɨnö al pak löl a göm, God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau kalɨp hagnɨg ara. Amöm haga, “Yad Jisas nɨp kain gɨ dapem kalöp ñeinabin u, yɨp nan nɨhön ñɨnabim?” ö ga. Hagö, nɨp silpa magö ñɨn juöl añɨ ap ado gɨ da unbö sɨduŋ laŋ (30) ñɨla.
Ñeila, Judas nɨpe, “Yad ai göl gem Jisas nɨp mumug gɨnö, nɨp ud sɨsɨ löm ud aröl,” a göm, gasɨ u nɨŋa.
Jisas bɨ nɨpe gau aip Pasopa nan ñɨŋla

Hainö nan ñɨŋeb kub Bred Yɨs Mɨdagöp a gɨmɨdal ñɨn u iƚ gö, ñɨn wañɨgnɨbö u nöp, bɨ nɨpe gau Jisas mɨdeia u apöm hagla, “Pasopa sipsip pi pak ñɨŋnabun ñɨn u söl mɨdöp. Anɨb u, hon ram mai amun nan ñɨŋnabun gau gɨ lɨ aij gun?” ö gɨla.

Hageila, kalɨp haga, “Kale daun kub u ammim, bɨ ap mɨdöp au ram nɨpe ammim nɨp hagmim, ‘Manö hag ñeb bɨ hagöp, “Ñɨn yad u söl mɨdöp u me, bɨ yad gau aip kaj sipsip pi pak lau ñɨŋnabun ram ne u,” a göp,’ a gɨmim,” a ga.
Jisas anɨg hagö, bɨ nɨpe gau haga rö nɨŋöm, amöm kaj sipsip anɨbu ram anɨbu pak lauöm, gɨ lɨ aij geila.
Dugo magö u, bɨ nɨpe unbö mɨgan laŋ gau aip asɨköm,
nan ñɨŋöl gɨ haga, “Yad kalöp nɨŋö hagabin, bɨ hon aip nan ñɨŋabun i, ap yɨp kain gɨ dam arnab,” a ga.
Hageia, bɨ nɨpe gau gasɨ mɨlö löm, añɨ añɨ nɨp hag nɨŋöl gɨ hagla, “Bɨ Kub! Yad hagpan aka?” gɨla.
Hageila haga, “Bɨ yad aip kɨnaŋ mɨgan añɨ ñɨŋabul i, yɨp kain gɨ dam arnab.

God Manö u hadame nöp kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm hagla rö, yɨp kain gɨ damöm, al pak lɨlö umnabin u, pen bɨ yɨp kain gɨ dam arnab u, God bɨ anɨbu nɨp gɨ naij gɨnab. Nɨme nɨp yag dauagböp u aij. Pen yag dauö, mɨdöl gɨ anɨg gɨnab u, hainö ilön kub yabɨƚ udnab,” a ga.
Hageia, bɨ nɨpe Judas, nɨp kain gɨnɨg ga u haga, “Manö hag ñeb bɨ. Yɨp hagagpan aka?” ga. Hageia haga, “Me nöp hagabin,” a ga.
Jisas bɨ nɨpe gau kalɨp bred ñɨg wain ña
Nan ñɨŋ mɨdöl gɨ, Jisas bred udöm, God nɨp aij a göm, ud jö göm, bɨ nɨpe gau kalɨp ñöl gɨ haga, “Kale ud ñɨŋim. U hañ romaŋ yad,” a ga.
Anɨg hagöm, ñɨg wain kap u, u rö nöp udöm, God nɨp aij a göm, kalɨp ñöl gɨ haga, “Kale magöŋhalö ñɨŋim.
U hagape yad lugnab u nöp. Lugö, God hadame gau haga manö u pɨdöŋ arnab. Lugö, nɨbi bɨ iru nöp nan si nan naij gɨpal gau, God nɨŋöm arö gɨnab,” a ga.
Anɨg hagöm haga, “Yad kalöp nɨŋö hagabin, ñɨg wain i mɨñi rɨmnap halö ñɨŋagnabin. Hainö, God nɨbi bɨ udöm kumi kabö adö laŋ au abad mɨdeinab ñɨn u nöp, yad kauyaŋ kale aip ñɨg wain u ñɨŋnabin,” a ga.
Anɨg hagöm, bɨ nɨpe gau aip God hib dap raneb kɨmap ap hagöl gɨ, Olip Dum arla.
Jisas Pida nɨp, “‘Jisas nɨp nɨŋagpin,’ a gɨnabön,” a ga
Jisas haga, “God Manö u kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm hagla,

content.text: ‘Yad bɨ kaj sipsip mukep u nɨp pak lɨnö,
kaj sipsip nɨpe gau magöŋhalö pɨñɨŋ gɨ arnaböl,’ a gɨla.

content: Hagla anɨbu me, mɨdö sɨbön aŋ yaŋ kale magöŋhalö yɨp arö gɨmim, pɨñɨŋ gɨ arnabim.
Pen yad umem urakem, ram mɨnöŋ Galili nöd areinabin, kale hain nɨnabim,” a ga.
Hageia, Pida haga, “Bɨ magöŋhalö nöp arö göm, jöl ñɨnaböl rö löp, pen yad anɨg gagnabin,” a ga.
Hageia, Jisas haga, “Yad nöp manö nɨŋö hagabin, sɨbön aŋ yaŋ yaur kɨƚakɨƚ wɨñ alagnab magö u, ‘Jisas nɨp nɨŋagpin,’ a gɨmön, magö mɨhau nɨgaŋ hagnabön,” a ga.
Hageia, Pida kƚö yabɨƚ göm haga, “Yɨp al pak lɨnɨg, al pak lɨnaböl u pen, ‘Jisas bɨ yad wasö,’ gem hagagnabin,” a ga. Jisas bɨ nɨpe magöŋhalö u rö nöp Pida haga rö nöp hagla.
Jisas God nɨp sabe gɨ mɨdeia
Jisas bɨ nɨpe gau aip mab wög adɨŋ Gedsemani amöm, bɨ nɨpe rɨmnap kalɨp haga, “Kale aui asɨk mɨdaimim. Yad au daŋ amem, Bapi nɨp sabe göl gɨ mɨdeinabin,” a ga.
Anɨg hagöm, Pida aip, Sebedi ñɨ nɨpe mɨhöp Jems Jon aip kalɨp uɫ gɨ ara. Amöl gɨ, Jisas nɨpe gasɨ mɨlö löm,
kalɨp yam haga, “Mɨdmagö yɨp u bɨg ñöl nöp löp u, umnam rö löp. Kale aui mɨdmim, yɨp abad mɨdaimim,” a ga.

Anɨg hagöm, kalɨp anɨb au hag löm, nɨpe yöp söl dagol au amöm, ubör yɨhöŋ göm, mulu adɨŋ u ud mɨnöŋ yaŋ löm, God nɨp sabe göm haga, “Bapi, nan yɨp gɨnɨg gab anɨbu, wasö gɨnɨg, wasö gɨmön. Pen yad gasɨ nɨŋbin adö u gagmön; gasɨ ne ke nɨŋban adö u rö gɨmön,” a ga.
Anɨg hagöm, ado gɨ apöm nɨŋa, bɨ nɨpe gau hon haneila. Jisas Pida nɨp haga, “Kale magö añɨ ap nöp yɨp abad mɨdagim ar?
Nan naij gun rö löp, a gɨmim, God nɨp sabe göl gɨ mɨdaimim. Gasɨ kale u gɨmim rö löp u pen hañ romaŋ u nöp masös göp,” a ga.
Jisas anɨg hagöm, kauyaŋ am Nap nɨp sabe göm haga, “Nan yɨp gɨnɨg gö ilön udnabin u, arö gep rö mɨdagöp u, haƚöwaƚö gaŋ; gasɨ ne ke nɨŋban adö u rö gɨmön,” a ga.
Anɨg hagöm, kauyaŋ ado gɨ apöm nɨŋa, bɨ nɨpe gau amgö nɨŋ mɨdageila; hon haneila.
Pen nɨpe ado gɨ amöm, Nap nɨp nöd sabe ga rö nöp, kauyaŋ sabe göm,
ado gɨ apöm, bɨ nɨpe gau kalɨp haga, “Kale masös gö, han mɨdpim arŋ Bɨ gau me, nɨŋim! Bɨ yɨp kain göm, Bɨ Ñɨ nɨpe, bɨ nan si nan naij gɨpal gau kalɨp ñɨnɨg gab.
Urakpe arun! Nɨŋim! Bɨ kain göp bɨ auab i,” a ga.
Judas Jisas nɨp kain gɨ ud ara

Jisas manö hagö nɨŋöl gɨ, bɨ nɨpe unbö mɨgan laŋ ap, Judas, bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau abe, bɨ manö ud asɨkep gau abe, nɨp hagla rö, bɨ kale iru nöp dapöm apjaka. Kale ru mɨlö kɨd rɨmnap, ur pakep rɨmnap udöm, aula.
Judas nöd kalɨp hag löm haga, “Yad bɨ ap nɨp am hag wɨhai udem, ud bom haluem, mulu ñɨŋeinam u, bɨ u me, a gɨmim, nɨp ud sɨsɨ lɨmim,” a ga.
Pen Judas nɨpe Jisas mɨdeia au yɨŋɨd nöp apjaköm, “Manö hag ñeb bɨ, ne mɨdpan?” a göm, nɨp mulu ñɨŋa.
Anɨg gö, Jisas haga, “Bɨ me. Nan gɨnɨg gabön u yɨŋɨd gɨ!” a ga. Hagö, bɨ Judas aip aula gau Jisas nɨp ud sɨsɨ lɨla.
Jisas ud sɨsɨ lɨlö nɨŋöl gɨ, Jisas bɨ nɨpe ap ru mɨlö kɨd nɨpe u ud ɫɨp gɨ udöm, bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub yabɨƚ u wög nɨp gɨmɨdöp bɨ u, nɨp rɨmɨd böŋ lap u böŋ nöp rɨb gɨ dö gɨ yua.
Anɨg gö, Jisas nɨp haga, “Ru mɨlö kɨd udpan u ado gɨ lɨ mɨgan yuö lugaŋ. Nɨbi bɨ ru mɨlö kɨd udöm pen pen gɨnaböl gau, adö anɨbu nöp umnaböl.
Yad ‘Bapi ake!’ gaibnep, nɨpe yɨŋɨd nöp ejol yam ke ke unbö mɨgan laŋ rö hag yuö, apöm yɨp abad mɨdaiblap.
Pen hadame nöp God Manö u kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm, yɨp anɨg anɨg göm umnab a gɨla u me, anɨg gɨnɨm. Yad adö ap ke geinabin u, kabö rö gagnab,” a ga.

Pen bɨ nɨp udnɨg aula anɨb gau kalɨp haga, “Yad pör am God sabe gep ram u asɨkem, nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp manö hag ñɨbin u pen yɨp udagpim. Mɨñi pen, ru mɨlö kɨd halö, ur pakep halö dapim, bɨ nan si udep rö u yɨp udnɨg auabim.
Kale gabim anɨbu, God manö hagep bɨ gau God Manö kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm hagla rö nöp gabim,” a ga. Pen magö anɨbu, Jisas bɨ nɨpe gau magöŋhalö nɨp arö göm pɨñɨŋ gɨ arla.
Juda Kansol Kub bɨ gau Jisas nɨp manö kub hagla
Pen God lo manö hag ñeb bɨ gau abe, bɨ manö ud asɨkep gau abe, ap magum gɨ mɨdeila bɨ Kaiapas God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub yabɨƚ u ram nɨpe au me, Jisas nɨp ud sɨsɨ löm, dam ram anɨbu arla.
Pen Pida nɨpe hain hain amöm, ram höŋ adö u mɨdöm, God sabe gep ram polisman gau aip asɨköm, nɨhön rö gɨnaböl a göm, nɨŋ mɨdeia.

Bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau abe, Juda Kansol kub bɨ gau abe hagla, “Hon bɨ manö piral hagep bɨ rɨmnap kalɨp hag nɨŋno, kale manö ap haglö, kabö göl mɨdö, manö iƚ me u, a gun, Jisas nɨp al pak lun,” a gɨla.
Anɨg hagla u pen manö anɨbu ke ke arö, Jisas nɨp al pak lep iƚ ap mɨdageia. Anɨg ga u pen hainö bɨ mɨhöp apil haglö,
“Bɨ anɨbi haga, ‘God sabe gep ram u ud jö gɨ yuem, mɨdö ñɨn mɨhau nɨgaŋ kauyaŋ gɨ lɨnabin,’ a ga,” a gɨlö.
Anɨg hagailö, God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub yabɨƚ u, Jisas nɨp haga, “Manö nöp hagabil u, ne pen ap hagagnabön ar?” a ga.

Hageia, Jisas pen manö ap hagaga. Anɨg gö, bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub yabɨƚ u haga, “Mɨñi manö kub hagnɨg mɨdpun i, manö piral hagagmön. God pör kamɨŋ mɨdöp u, u rö nöp nɨŋ mɨdöp. Anɨb u, hanɨp kabö göl hagmön: ne Mesaia u, God Ñɨ nɨpe aka wasö?” ga.

Hageia, Jisas haga, “Me hagpan u. Pen kale magöŋhalö nɨŋim! Yad kalöp hagabin, yad Bɨ Kub kƚö ke yabɨƚ u ñɨmagö yɨjɨg böŋ nɨpe lau adö mɨdem, kumi bad adö au amem mɨnöŋ naböŋ iƚ i aueinabin u nɨŋnabim,” a ga.

Jisas anɨg hagö, bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub yabɨƚ u, waƚɨj nɨpe gau ke ud bɨƚɨƚɨ göl gɨ haga, “Nɨpe God hib u rɨb juajɨp nɨŋbim! Anɨb u, nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap hag nɨŋagun. Nɨpe gɨ naij göp u waiö hagöp me u.
Aka kale gasɨ nɨhön nɨŋabim?” ö ga. Hageia hagla, “Me hagöp me u; umaŋ añɨ,” a gɨla.
Anɨg hagöm, mulu maj mɨgan nɨp u kɨñu al ñöm, paköl gɨ gɨla. Rɨmnap Jisas amgö magö nɨpe paƚu gɨ ñöm, alaun nɨpe gau paköl gɨ,
hagla, “Ne Mesaia u, an nöp pakab u, hanɨp hagö nɨŋun,” a gɨla.
Pida, “Jisas nɨp nɨŋagpin,” a ga
Pen Pida manö kub hagep ram höŋ adö yaŋ asɨk mɨdeia u me, bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub yabɨƚ u nɨp wög gɨmɨdöp pai ap apöm, nɨp haga, “Ne Jisas bɨ Galili nɨbö u aip mɨdajɨl,” a ga.
Hagö, Pida nɨbi bɨ gau magöŋhalö nɨŋ mɨdlö nɨŋöl gɨ, haga, “Manö ne hagabön u yad nɨŋagpin,” a ga.
Anɨg hagöm, uraköm, am ajöŋ iƚ au mɨdö nɨŋöl gɨ, nɨbi ram anɨbu wög gɨmɨdöp ap apöm, Pida nɨp nɨŋöm, nɨbi bɨ mɨdeila gau kalɨp haga, “Nɨpe bɨ Jisas Nasared nɨbö u aip mɨdailö nɨŋbin,” a ga.
Hagö, Pida wai ñöm haga, “Yad nɨŋö yabɨƚ hagabin, bɨ hagpim anɨbu yad nɨŋagpin,” a ga.
Pro magö ap mɨdöm, nɨbi bɨ Pida aip urak mɨdeila gau nɨp hagla, “Nɨŋö nöp hagpun. Ne bɨ kale ap. Meg mɨgan kale hagpal rö, ne u rö nöp hagpan,” a gɨla.
Hageila, Pida bƚaƚö göm haga, “Yad kalöp nɨŋö yabɨƚ hagabin. Wasö u, God yɨp ilön mab ñɨnɨm aij. Bɨ kale hagpim anɨbu yad nɨŋagpin!” a ga. Anɨg hagö nɨŋöl gɨ, adɨŋ yaur kɨƚakɨƚ u wɨñ ala.

Kɨƚakɨƚ u wɨñ alö, Pida Jisas manö nɨp nöd haga anɨbu gasɨ nɨŋöm, gasɨ mɨlö la. Nɨhön gɨnɨg: Jisas haga, “Yaur kɨƚakɨƚ wɨñ alagnab magö u, ‘Jisas nɨp nɨŋagpin,’ a gɨmön, magö mɨhau nɨgaŋ hagnabön,” a ga. Gasɨ anɨbu nɨŋöm me, gasɨ mɨlö löm, höŋ amöm, mɨɫöŋ kub ga.
